{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all fresh ideas generated within the team. It captures the idea, context, potential impact, and next steps.

## Format
| Idea ID | Title | Description | Owner | Priority | Status | Notes |
|---------|-------|-------------|-------|----------|--------|-------|

### Example
| 001 | Automate report generation | Build a script to auto-generate weekly sales reports. | Alice | 3 | In Progress | Requires API access.

## Guidelines
- **Idea ID**: Auto‑incremented.
- **Title**: Short, descriptive.
- **Description**: One or two sentences.
- **Owner**: Person responsible.
- **Priority**: 1 (low) – 5 (high).
- **Status**: Draft / In Progress / Completed / Archived.
- **Notes**: Any additional info.

Feel free to add more columns if needed.
", "file_name": "FreshIdeasTracker.txt"}
